quests.title: The Quest Board
quests.subtitle: New contracts are pinned at dawn. Sealed quests renew tomorrow.
quests.renewNote: The board renews at midnight, traveler.

trials.title: Trials of the Arena
trials.subtitle: Step into the rune circle. Each trial lists its rites — complete them all.

achievements.title: Honors & Relics
achievements.hallRemembers: The hall remembers every deed, traveler — even those yet to come.

guide.title: The Arcane Guide
guide.greeting: You have returned, traveler. What shall we improve today?
guide.thinking: The Guide weaves a spell of wisdom…
guide.prompt4: How can I improve my endurance?

character.title: Your Hero
character.syncNote: Your XP, attributes and streaks are mirrored to the cloud.
character.oathReleased: Your oath is released — progress stays on this device.
character.localOnly: Your legend lives only on this device. Swear an oath at the Oath Stone to sync it across the realms.
character.resetConfirm: Abandon your legend and begin anew? All XP, stats and honors will be lost.
character.resetDone: The mists clear — a new legend begins.

progress.title: Your Legend
progress.noDeeds: No deeds recorded yet. Conquer a trial and the scribes will write of you.

auth.intro: Bind your legend to the arcane archives so your XP, stats and streaks follow you everywhere.

path-of-endurance.description: Walk or run 3 km beneath the open sky.

guardians-discipline.name: Guardian's Discipline
guardians-discipline.auto: Seals itself when you conquer any trial.

feast-of-the-keep.name: Feast of the Keep
feast-of-the-keep.description: Eat a protein-rich meal and drink 2 L of water.

iron-chest.name: Trial of the Iron Chest

emberforged-sword.name: Emberforged Sword
emberforged-sword.flavor: Quenched in dragonfire, warm to the touch.

moonlit-runesaber.name: Moonlit Runesaber
moonlit-runesaber.flavor: Its runes glow beneath a full moon.

dragonfang-greatblade.name: Dragonfang Greatblade

runebound-aegis.flavor: Wards hum softly across the plates.

celestial-warplate.name: Celestial Warplate
celestial-warplate.flavor: Forged from a fallen star's heart.

cracked-mana-stone.name: Cracked Mana Stone

heart-of-aethora.name: Heart of Aethora
